youtube_title: Refund Call Says Install This App and Share Your Screen? Scam of the Week #9 #Shorts
youtube_description:
SCAM OF THE WEEK #9. Your refund is stuck, then a call: install this app and share your screen to get it. A or B?
Answer: B, cut the call. RBI and NPCI have warned that screen-sharing apps like AnyDesk are used for fraud: once you share your screen, the scammer sees your OTP, PIN and banking app live. No real refund needs you to install an app, and you never need a PIN to receive money. Get refunds only through the official app or website. Scammed? Call 1930 or report at cybercrime.gov.in.
Sources: RBI Alert 1/2019, NPCI advisory (Feb 2019).
